Name: Maono Mic Mute
Description: Mute and unmute a Maono microphone with a key press, through Maono Link — the real mute, with the device LED. The key shows whether the microphone is muted.

Actions.Name: Toggle Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mute or unmute the Maono microphone (the device LED lights); the key shows whether it is muted

Localization.Maono Link is not running, or the microp: Maono Link is not running, or the microphone panel is not open.
Localization.This mutes the microphone itself through: This mutes the microphone itself through Maono Link — the device mute LED lights, the same as its own mute button.
Localization.Keep Maono Link running with your microp: Keep Maono Link running with your microphone panel open; otherwise the key cannot reach the mute.
Localization.Open Maono Link and show your microphone: Open Maono Link and show your microphone so the key can mute it.
Localization.Could not change the mute of the microph: Could not change the mute of the microphone.
